# airflow_fab_user (Data Source)

Fetches an Airflow FAB user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "airflow_fab_user" "admin" {
  username       = "admin"
}

output "admin_user" {
  value = data.airflow_fab_user.admin
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean)
- `changed_on` (String)
- `created_on` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `fail_login_count` (Number)
- `first_name` (String)
- `last_login` (String)
- `last_name` (String)
- `login_count` (Number)
- `roles` (Set of String)
